additionalProjectionEvidence: Football opportunity extension follows inspection of the projection-level validation report; this is explicitly a development experiment, not untouched final testing. No extra family is selected from a final test.
footballHypothesis: Fixed ridge forecasts of passing volume, team play budgets, target and carry counts can replace pooled opportunity shares; the conditional play/state model and shared scoring outcomes remain intact.
promotion: No automatic promotion. Preregistered accuracy/reliability gates and genuine pregame publication evidence required.
sampling: First three preselected game IDs per league/window; no outcome-dependent replacement
